title: Normalized endpoint and middle data for smooth exchange scalar compatibility
statement: For the Cartesian square and every pair of constructible exceptional coefficient systems S for f and S' for f', there exist simultaneous adic purity data and normalized localized families at f and f', endpoint equations identifying the scalar comparisons, canonical gamma identifications, and a natural isomorphism m between the twisted-pullback endpoints. The components of m are the canonical `middle` comparison, and m satisfies the scalar square and shift compatibility needed to paste the exchange.

source.place: returned parent proof step 4: normalization of the supplied exceptional systems and the middle shifted pullback comparison

proof.text: Construct the simultaneous adic purity data for the supplied exceptional systems, with the normalized finite-right realization and compatible source and target shifts.
Apply the rational endpoint theorem to obtain localized families, endpoint equations, and the canonical rational purity identifications.

Use the canonical tensor, pullback, shifted root-line, and twisted square comparisons to define m. Naturality, scalar coherence, and shift coherence give the displayed component, scalar, and shift equations.
